title: Leg of Mutton
summary: Provides 5 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.

fields.Camp Supplies: 5 points. Standard full Long Rest requires 40 supplies, while Tactician and Honour typically require 80.
fields.Acquisition: Found in loot or sold by traders.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
